where: Pour ceci, soit ℝ le faisceau des sections de R sur S, et introduisons le O_S-Module
scan: soit IR (I and R overstruck: a double-struck R)
note: The sheaf of sections of R is written \underline{R} in (13.4.1) just below, in '(13.1.3) \underline{R} \longrightarrow \underline{E}' at the foot of the page and on the following pages, while the double-struck R is the real numbers in 13.1.5 (R \otimes_Z \mathbb{R}). Typist's error; the TeX keeps the printed double-struck R.

The superscripts 1 and -1 are swapped in the print: as printed the Hodge filtration increases (Fil^0 = F inside Fil^1 = ℰ). p. 498 states that, 'avec les conventions de degrés (13.4.6)', the Hodge filtration induced on ℰ^t (which meets F in 0, 13.4.10) is concentrated in degree -1 and that on ℰ/ℰ^f (F + ℰ^f = ℰ, 13.4.13) in degree 0; both hold only for the decreasing filtration Fil^{-1} = ℰ, Fil^0 = F, Fil^1 = 0 (Deligne's convention for weight -1: F^0 = ker(H_C -> Lie)). p. 495 also remarks of the weight filtration 'il s'agit donc d'une filtration croissante', which presupposes a decreasing Hodge filtration. An error of the original rather than a recovered reading: swap both superscripts together in the corrected edition, or add a note. The TeX keeps the print.
